title: Node JS
body:
Another name for [[Node.js]], which is where this material lives. Also written **Node**, and
[[Server JS]] in the lecture headings.

The one thing worth keeping straight is that `Node` in this vault is ambiguous:
[[COMP 1ST YEAR/COMP 1633/Node|Node]] in COMP 1633 is a linked-list node, a struct with a
pointer in it, and has nothing to do with the server runtime. Link [[Node.js]] and the
question does not arise.
